summary: Launch QA — money/critical-paths validation. 11/11 backend tests PASS covering Auth (master admin, operator owner, CRM login, Site-A manager restricted from Site-B via X-Site-Id → 403 site_access_denied), CRM v2 org-scoping (companies/opportunities, platform token rejected on CRM), Memberships (list + create with GDPR/phone required, persistence verified via GET), and Memberships Billing (monthly-invoice generate returned 200, no 500s; sample statement PDF renders via document-branding sample.pdf → %PDF bytes, >500B, content-type application/pdf). Frontend smoke: owner login succeeds and lands on /service-desk (owner has is_service_desk=true). Cookie banner overlays login button — dismiss 'Essential Only' first to click Sign In cleanly.

ui_bugs.issue: Cookie consent banner (Essential Only / Accept All) overlaps the Sign In button area on /login. First click on Sign In can be intercepted until the banner is dismissed. Recommend auto-dismiss or z-index/positioning fix so the CTA is always clickable.

Direct navigation to /memberships/members returns the app 404 page for an owner logged into the Service Desk area (Pulse Fitness · 404). Owner needs to 'Switch area' to Memberships first; deep links to memberships sub-routes should either auto-switch area or resolve to the correct route.

action_items: Consider fixing cookie banner overlap on /login so Sign In is always immediately clickable.
Consider making /memberships/members a valid deep-link that auto-switches area (or redirect via router) so owner in Service Desk area doesn't hit 404.

PDF endpoint used for verification is /api/document-branding/sample.pdf (uses the same _render_invoice_pdf renderer). There is no per-invoice GET .../invoice/{id}/pdf endpoint — consider exposing one for on-demand download without triggering /send.
critical_code_review_comments: studio_billing.py is ~1472 lines — approaching the >700-line split threshold; consider extracting rendering + email templating into a dedicated module for maintainability.

POST /api/memberships/members returns {member: {...}} wrapper while some other list endpoints return arrays or {items: [...]} — inconsistent envelope shapes across memberships routes make frontend/test code fragile.

No dedicated per-invoice PDF endpoint (invoice/{id}/pdf). Currently PDF bytes are only produced inside generate + send flows and the sample renderer. Adding a GET endpoint (owner-authenticated, org-scoped) would help operator workflow and simplify QA.
CRM/platform token separation confirmed working (platform bearer rejected on /api/crm/v2/* with 401/403). Good.

success_rate.frontend: smoke only — login OK, service-desk dashboard renders; memberships console not deep-linked.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend money-path test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_launch_qa_moneypaths_jan2026.py — reusable regression. Session-scoped fixtures cache tokens and self-space logins ~35s apart to dodge the aggressive /api/auth/login rate limit. If retesting quickly after another auth-heavy suite, expect the master/owner/manager login fixtures to take ~2 minutes total. For future PDF checks the sample.pdf endpoint (/api/document-branding/sample.pdf) is the fastest way to smoke the _render_invoice_pdf renderer.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found on the QA-scoped surface. Two minor frontend UX findings (cookie banner overlap on /login and 404 on /memberships/members deep link when owner is in Service Desk area) documented above.
